tracks.title: 핑크 반장
tracks.mood: mock-heroic, proud, soft-hearted under the pomp
tracks.subject: Rebar foreman Mr Bae's six-year-old daughter paints his nails bright pink on Sunday night and makes him promise not to wipe it off, so he runs Monday's 7 a.m. safety briefing bare-handed, and by Friday every man on his crew has one pink pinky.
